The '''1994–95 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 59th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 24 September 1994 and ended on 4 June 1995. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 17th Greek title and their first one in four years.
